_note: Metadata preview samples only. The first is the dry-run fixture. The other two are made-up examples to show other scam types; they are never published and were not fact-checked.

samples.title: Unpaid toll text with a late fee: real or scam?
samples.description: This text says you owe a small toll and must pay today to avoid a fee. Don't tap the link.
samples.safeMove: Check your toll account by typing the address you already use.
samples.body: Toll Services: you have an unpaid toll of $4.15. Pay today to avoid a $50 late fee: pay-tolls.example

samples.title: A job offer by text that pays for easy tasks: real or scam?
samples.description: This text offers easy remote work and asks you to reply to start. Real employers don't hire like this.
samples.body: Hi! We're hiring for remote work, 1 hour a day, $300 daily. Reply YES to start.
